answer: At the jetty, every identity passes a velvet rope by whispering its credential to three neighbors, who compare the whispers: one voice cannot vouch for ten mouths. Each whisper costs a one-time 90 POA binding fee, held four epochs, never refunded, and a copied whisper is caught because its voiceprint matches another's — the fee is kept and the identity is barred from every jetty for six epochs. Ten clones need ten distinct live voices and ten fees; a neighbor who passes a copy loses 40 POA of standing per fake, so none vouches twice for the same voice, and the cost cannot be pooled or reused.
